spec.description: Everything about one device: its verdict history, signals, baseline and its own tuning.

options.content: Pick a device in the **device** box at the top. Every panel follows it.

spec.title: Verdict over time
spec.description: 0 Benign · 1 Anomalous · 2 Suspicious · 3 High · 4 Critical.

spec.title: Confidence and backing
spec.description: Verdict confidence (0-1), with the independent sources and evidence families behind it.

spec.title: Alerts sent (24h)
spec.description: Alerts about this device that reached you.

spec.expr: (home_ids_device_alerts_fired_24h) * on(device) group_left(hostname) (max by (device, hostname) (home_ids_decision_state{hostname=~"$device"}) * 0 + 1) or vector(0)

spec.title: Hidden as false positive (24h)
spec.description: Alerts about this device the filter hid.

spec.expr: (home_ids_device_alerts_suppressed_24h) * on(device) group_left(hostname) (max by (device, hostname) (home_ids_decision_state{hostname=~"$device"}) * 0 + 1) or vector(0)

spec.title: Learned trust
spec.description: How much the false-positive filter trusts this device's usual behaviour.

spec.title: Sensitivity shift
spec.description: Below 0: stricter after confirmed threats. Above 0: more lenient after corrected false positives.

spec.title: Behaviour changes learned
spec.description: Lasting behaviour changes its baseline detected and re-learned.

spec.expr: (home_ids_device_baseline_regime_shifts) * on(device) group_left(hostname) (max by (device, hostname) (home_ids_decision_state{hostname=~"$device"}) * 0 + 1) or vector(0)

spec.title: Kill-chain stage
spec.description: Which attack stage its traffic most resembles (suspected).

spec.title: ⚙️ How autotune has tuned this device

options.content: Autotune picks a value per device when it has enough evidence, otherwise per device type, otherwise the global value.

spec.title: This device's own tuned thresholds
spec.description: Thresholds autotune calibrated specifically for the selected device(s), and proposals still in their trial (canary) period.

spec.expr: max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(home_ids_autotune_value{scope="device"}, "device", "$1", "target", "(.*)")) * on(device) group_left(hostname) (max by (device, hostname) (home_ids_decision_state{hostname=~"$device"}) * 0 + 1), "key", " · ", "hostname", "parameter"))

max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(home_ids_autotune_canary_value{scope="device"}, "device", "$1", "target", "(.*)")) * on(device) group_left(hostname) (max by (device, hostname) (home_ids_decision_state{hostname=~"$device"}) * 0 + 1), "key", " · ", "hostname", "parameter"))

properties.value: The value in force for this device.
A proposed new value still being tested before promotion.

spec.title: Its device type's values
spec.description: What the selected device(s) fall back to where they have no value of their own.

spec.expr: max by (key) (label_join(home_ids_autotune_value{scope="category"} and on(target) label_replace(max by (device_type) (home_ids_decision_state{hostname=~"$device"}), "target", "$1", "device_type", "(.*)"), "key", " · ", "target", "parameter"))

properties.value: Calibrated for all devices of this type.

spec.title: Global values
spec.description: Used by every device without a more specific value.

properties.value: The hand-set config.yaml value it started from.

options.content: The raw inputs behind the anomaly score. Several moving together matters more than one spike.

spec.title: DNS queries per minute
spec.description: Raw lookup rate. Read together with randomness and z-score.

spec.title: Query rate vs its learned limit
spec.description: The learned normal rate and the live alert threshold derived from it.

spec.title: Unusualness vs its own history (z-score)
spec.description: Above ~3 is a statistical outlier for this device.

spec.title: Blocked and failed lookups
spec.description: Share of lookups Pi-hole blocked, and share that returned 'no such domain'. Rising failures without blocks can mean a DGA probing for its C2.

spec.title: Domain-name randomness
spec.description: Above ~4.5 suggests machine-generated names.

spec.title: Beaconing: volume and regularity
spec.description: Regular timing (low jitter) plus steady volume is the C2 check-in pattern.

spec.title: ML outlier score
spec.description: How unusual the device looks to its own anomaly model.

spec.title: Unusual behaviour sequence (Markov)
spec.description: How unlikely its current behaviour sequence is, given its history.

spec.title: External reputation
spec.description: Threat-intel, AbuseIPDB and VirusTotal scores for its destinations.

options.content: Raw alert records for this device from the log stream (Loki).

spec.title: This device's alerts
spec.description: Every candidate alert for the selected device, published or not.

spec.expr: {job="home_ids_alerts"} | json | type="ids_alert" | device_hostname=~"$device" | json signature="signature", risk="risk", why="hee_decision_path", fp_verdict="fp_verdict.verdict", suppressed="suppressed"
